Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We're moving the Edge Integration SOW through procurement and need to confirm Redwood's downstream controls. Can you send the list of subcontractors (by role) that will touch customer data for the hosted offering, plus any standard flow-down language you require in our Order Form / MSA?

Best,

From: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com

Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 14:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Subprocessor flow-down for Edge Integration

Sam / Jasmine —

Thanks for the context. Per procurement's ask, legal reviewed the SOW and the attached Order Form excerpt and here are our suggested positions (high level):

- Subprocessor list: we can provide a current, role-based list plus a notice/consent process for adding new subprocessors. We do not provision specific vendor names in the MSA by default — that creates churn — but we will populate the Order Form with the current roster at signing.

- Flow-down clause: proposed language below (to be included in Order Form Annex A):
  "Redwood's Subprocessors: Redwood may engage subprocessors to perform portions of the Services. Redwood shall ensure each subprocessor is subject to written obligations at least as protective as those set forth in this Agreement and the DPA. Redwood shall provide Customer with prior notice of any new subprocessor that will process Customer Data and shall permit Customer to object within thirty (30) days on reasonable grounds related to data protection. In the event of an objection, the parties shall work in good faith to address Customer's concerns."

- DPA / SOC2: we'll attach the DPA and a SOC 2 auditor summary. For procurement: if Acme requires KMS-level evidence or an architecture diagram showing key management split, please flag that now — we may need to involve infra/security and that can add time.

- Indemnity / SLA carveouts: our standard is to limit downstream liability for subcontractor failures where Redwood has exercised reasonable vendor management. If Acme wants broader indemnity for subprocessors explicitly, that will need legal escalation and a counterpart commercial adjustment.

I've prepared a redline_draft.docx with edits on the MSA and Order Form; attaching it to this thread. We'll also include the requested CSV mapping in our package.

--
Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Contracts & Procurement
Redwood Inference
attachments: redline_draft.docx
